_meta.title: Slovakia: Roma settlements (Atlas of Roma Communities 2019)
_meta.what_it_measures: Every Roma settlement in the 2019 Atlas, with its type (outside the village, on its edge, or inside it), population range, number and kind of dwellings (including shacks and caravans), road and footpath access, physical barriers in front of the settlement (river, railway, field, forest, wall), distance from the village, who owns the land, and utilities. Field names are the Atlas column headings in Slovak.
